related.title: JavaScript：事件迴圈與 microtask 順序
related.titleEn: JavaScript: event loops and microtask ordering
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付stack-trace.csv與驗證失敗案例；簡化ISA不直接解析.class完整格式。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver stack-trace.csv and verification failures; the simplified ISA does not parse full.class files. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 把call stack、microtask queue、task queue分欄，逐步移動紀錄，避免用延遲數值猜順序。
related.differenceEn: Separate call stack, microtask queue and task queue, moving records stepwise instead of guessing from delay values.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
operand stack的型別與高度必須沿控制流一致；位元碼驗證與執行結果是兩層不同條件。
本課數值核對：(2+3)*4 = 20 result；另一項核對：max(1,2) = 2 slots。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

同步程式先完成，microtask checkpoint再處理排隊工作；timer延遲不是精確排程保證。
本課數值核對：2+1+1 = 4 log_entries；另一項核對：2+1 = 3 B_position。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Operand-stack types and heights must agree across control flow; bytecode verification and the eventual computed result are separate conditions.
Numeric audit: (2+3)*4 = 20 result; second audit: max(1,2) = 2 slots. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Synchronous code finishes before a microtask checkpoint processes queued work; timer delay is not an exact scheduling guarantee.
Numeric audit: 2+1+1 = 4 log_entries; second audit: 2+1 = 3 B_position. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ELF 與動態連結：重定位和 ASLR
related.titleEn: ELF and dynamic linking: relocation and ASLR
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付stack-trace.csv與驗證失敗案例；簡化ISA不直接解析.class完整格式。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver stack-trace.csv and verification failures; the simplified ISA does not parse full.class files. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫file offset、virtual offset與loaded address三欄；為每個relocation記類型，不混用PC-relative。
related.differenceEn: Separate file offsets, virtual offsets and loaded addresses, recording relocation type without confusing PC-relative rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
operand stack的型別與高度必須沿控制流一致；位元碼驗證與執行結果是兩層不同條件。
本課數值核對：(2+3)*4 = 20 result；另一項核對：max(1,2) = 2 slots。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

重定位把符號與載入位置合成位址；ASLR改變base而非每個相對offset。不同relocation種類有不同公式。
本課數值核對：4096+288 = 4384 address；另一項核對：32768+288 = 33056 address。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Operand-stack types and heights must agree across control flow; bytecode verification and the eventual computed result are separate conditions.
Numeric audit: (2+3)*4 = 20 result; second audit: max(1,2) = 2 slots. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Relocations combine symbols with load positions; ASLR changes the base rather than every relative offset. Different relocation types use different formulas.
Numeric audit: 4096+288 = 4384 address; second audit: 32768+288 = 33056 address. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
